free.whyBody: RTYLR builds point-of-sale software for restaurants and cafés. We give $t(pager.brand.name) away so owners can experience how we design and ship products, with something genuinely useful on their counter today.

faq.title: Questions owners ask
faq.intro: Straight answers about how $t(pager.brand.name) works on your counter.

items.q: Does my customer need to download an app or sign up?
items.a: No. They point their phone camera at the QR on your counter and their ticket opens right in the browser. No app, no account, and nothing for them to type.

items.q: Does it work with my existing POS, or without one?
items.a: Yes to both. $t(pager.brand.name) runs in any browser on a phone, tablet, or computer beside your register, so it works alongside whatever POS you already use or on its own.

items.q: What happens on iPhone versus Android?
items.a: After scanning, the guest taps Notify me once. On Android Chrome, that enables the loud in-page ring, vibration, screen wake-lock, and lock-screen push notifications even if they switch apps or lock the phone. On iPhone Safari, browser tabs do not support web push or vibration, so that tap unlocks loud ringing (even with the silent switch on) and keeps the screen awake while the page stays open.

items.q: What if a customer doesn't have a phone or their battery died?
items.a: You never have to force every order through the pager. Just hand them a receipt or call their name or number like you do today, while everyone else scans.

items.q: Is it really free? What is the catch?
items.a: Really free, with no trial period, no subscription, and no order cap. RTYLR builds a point-of-sale platform and gives $t(pager.brand.name) away so owners can see our craft firsthand.

items.q: How do I start using it in my venue?
items.a: Sign up with your venue name and phone number, switch on the pager, and print your counter poster or open the counter display. You can try the full board and phone right now in the live demo first.

closing.title: Hear it ring for yourself
closing.subtitle: Play both the staff board and the customer's phone side by side in your browser. No signup needed.
